area: Filter and Display and View Options
title: Capacity Bars toggle shows and hides the per-day capacity bars
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. Shifts exist so capacity bars have fill.
3. You are on the Schedule page in week view with Capacity Bars ON (default).
steps: 1. Confirm the bars are visible in the day column headers.
2. Turn OFF Capacity Bars in 'View Options'.
expected: 1. Off: the capacity bars disappear from the column headers.
2. On: they reappear with the same values.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
